usedFor: inflow-inventory holds orders and customers, and Kylas CRM receives a lead after “New Sales Order Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Sales Order Created” in inflow-inventory, then “Create or Update Lead” in Kylas CRM
bestTemplate.why: A sales order names a buyer, and the action updates or skips if that phone or email exists.

watchOut: “Delete Lead” in Kylas CRM removes a lead outright, so keep it off “Update Customer” unless you mean it.
